checks.name: fixed candidate SHA
checks.detail: Exact Git archive; 23 implementation files from docs-only intermediate commit. All 13 developer source hashes match candidate and tested production files; shared production files have no diff from candidate.

checks.name: independent QA report
checks.detail: 52 executed backend checks (42 replayed original cases plus 10 independent negatives) and 30 actual-browser component checks (15 each desktop/narrow, including 5 independent cases each). No blocking candidate defect found.

checks.name: provider schema and input binding
checks.detail: Captured actual SDK request: strict JSON schema, closed objects and all fields required; no model assetId; distinct reference and candidate images ordered with correct labels and detail. Missing either image avoids SDK; empty/rejected SDK output throws instead of inventing observations.

checks.name: coordinate null visibility and untrusted input
checks.detail: Finite normalized boxes; reject all negative/zero/overflow/extra-field/wrong-ID/missing-field shapes without clamping; null reasons, invisible/low states and legal explicit full frame. One bad side preserves good partner; original raw evidence immutable.

checks.name: serialization readback and legacy compatibility
checks.detail: Actual existing SQLite migrations/repository write/read/API JSON for observations, issues, limitations, raw, model/prompt/engine/policy versions. Invalid JSON roots and visibility hide boxes without mutating stored historical payloads or verdict; old boundingRegions not reinterpreted.

checks.name: conservative verdict boundaries
checks.detail: Missing/null/invalid localization alone does not alter sufficiently observed match/mismatch. Partial coverage, reference/candidate not observable, duplicates and missing/unexpected requested checks remain REVIEW. Existing risk policy unchanged.

checks.name: actual component geometry desktop narrow and zoom
checks.detail: Desktop 1280x720 and real narrow iframe 373x1498; distinct 320x160 and 120x240 images. Native range input 150/200 percent preserves box fractions within .003; scrolling supports zoom, responsive columns 2/1. Native broken-image handling and changed URL recovery on same component, low/invisible no-box states, invalid-opposite side and persisted ProductChecker restored.

checks.name: required policy regression typecheck and one build
checks.detail: Reviewed original developer command outputs, exit 0 for policy regression, final typecheck and exactly one Next 16.2.12 production build (73 pages); final indexed source hashes all match candidate. These are reviewed developer executions, not claimed as independent reruns. No broad build rerun.

checks.name: scope and repository preservation
checks.detail: Runtime change excludes auth, credits, queue, migration, pricing, dependency additions; package only adds test entry. Shared uncommitted controller registry and two original production logs preserved. QA wrote only temp artifacts; no commit/push/deploy/production action.

originalFailures.cause: Original test compared undefined JS optional fields to serialized JSON; fixed expectation. Preserved in candidate.
QA mutation used nonexistent product_issues table. No candidate defect; actual table analysis_issues.
First harness correction still used nonexistent analysis_product_issues table. Diagnosed against repository insert/read SQL and corrected to analysis_issues; original failures retained.

limits: Controlled SDK boundary and synthetic images, no real model call or localization accuracy/cost claim.
Actual repository on in-memory SQLite with existing migrations; not production D1/R2 or transaction verification.
Browser uses original actual production components with controlled auth/billing/analytics/fetch; narrow validation uses real iframe viewport, not a top-level mobile journey.
Temp QA harness adds tests; production implementation stays byte-identical to fixed candidate. Typecheck/policy/build accepted from inspected original developer executions with matched source hashes.
Whole shared tree is not clean: controller-owned registry and original logs are excluded. Production candidate files are clean; release must independently enforce full constitution.
No production verification or release authorization for UPG-04; local QA PASS permits only RELEASE_READY.
